introduction: Kern General Assistance provides limited support to county residents without another means of support. DHS handles applications locally.
description: Kern General Assistance provides limited support to county residents without another means of support. DHS handles applications locally.

sections.who: Single adults and couples without minor children may qualify. DHS checks financial circumstances and other program conditions.
sections.get: Support may address rent, utilities, transportation and personal needs. A Disability Advocate can help GA applicants pursue SSI.
sections.docs:
• Ask DHS for its current verification checklist.
  • Income, resources, residence and relevant medical information.
sections.apply:
1. Obtain intake

    Use the forms on Kern General Assistance.

  2. Apply locally

    Visit DHS or call 661-631-6000 or877-410-8812. Listed intake hours are weekdays 7:30 a.m.–4 p.m.

  3. Complete review

    Return documents and discuss other benefit or disability-advocacy options.
sections.after: Read the decision and ongoing conditions. Ask DHS about any repayment obligation before accepting assistance.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Kern General Assistance. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is GA the same as CalWORKs?
GA targets qualifying adults without minor children.
Can I also seek food or health coverage?
DHS notes potential CalFresh and Medi-Cal eligibility.
Ask about the DHS Disability Advocate program.
